error.knowledge.knowledgeChunkMapper.cit.zh-CN: 保存的资料位置无法读取
error.knowledge.knowledgeChunkMapper.cit.en: The saved source location could not be read.

error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchTerms.pre.zh-CN: 知识检索词的摘要无法生成
error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchTerms.pre.en: The knowledge search term digest could not be generated.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 知识库已停用，请先启用。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: The knowledge base is disabled. Enable it first.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 一次请选择一至十份不同的资料。
每个知识库最多保存一千份资料。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: A knowledge base can contain up to 1,000 documents.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 资料尚未通过检查，请等待文件检查完成。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: The document has not passed validation. Wait for the file check to finish.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 这份文件已在知识库中，请选择“重新处理”。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: This file is already in the knowledge base. Choose Reprocess.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 这份文件已经加入知识库，请选择新的文件。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: This file is already in the knowledge base. Select a new file.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 资料正在排队或处理中，请等待处理完成。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: The document is queued or being processed. Wait for it to finish.

error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.zh-CN: 资料处理次数已达到上限，请重新上传文件。
error.knowledge.knowledgeDocumentService.en: This document reached its processing attempt limit. Upload it again.

error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingTrans.zh-CN: 知识资料写入批次不正确
error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingTrans.en: The knowledge source write batch is invalid.

error.knowledge.knowledgeReferenceServic.en: This AI employee is not configured to use the selected reference material. Select available material or contact its maintainer.

error.knowledge.knowledgeReferenceServic.zh-CN: 所选资料版本尚未完成或已不可读取，请重新选择。
error.knowledge.knowledgeReferenceServic.en: This reference version is unfinished or inaccessible. Select another version.

error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchService.s.zh-CN: 请输入二至五百个字符的检索内容。
error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchService.s.en: Enter a search query of 2–500 characters.

error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchService.s.zh-CN: 每次最多读取八段资料。
error.knowledge.knowledgeSearchService.s.en: Read up to eight passages per request.

error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.zh-CN: 文件服务暂时不可用，等待重试。
error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.en: The file service is temporarily unavailable. Waiting to retry.

error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.zh-CN: 处理发起人已无法编辑这份资料。
error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.en: The initiator can no longer edit this source.

error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.zh-CN: 资料暂时无法完成处理，等待重试。
error.knowledge.knowledgeProcessingWorke.en: The source cannot finish processing right now. Waiting to retry.
